name: Feathers & All
summary:
Miss Nevermore arrives at the country estate of a family friend. Summer has begun to bleed out at the hands of fall, and the city has been buzzing since the hottest of days, about the affairs of house Noblesse. Apparently one of their children has gone missing. They had run away to be with their darling, leaving the next eldest to carry on the burden of their family name. Miss Nevermore has heard the whispers from behind closed doors, however. And rumour has it… That the truth is far more malicious below the neatly smoothed out surface.

The doors creak open.

Time to see if the rumours are true.
